9The Minister, by himself or herself or by his or her architects, engineers, agents and workers, may

(a)
enter on any land, survey and take levels of that land and make borings or sink trial pits as he or she deems necessary for any purpose relative to a public work,

enter on any land for the purpose of making drains in which to carry off water from a public work and of keeping those drains in repair, and

alter the course of a watercourse and road and change the level of the watercourse and road.
